item.subject: science
item.stem:
Arjun keeps a science homework diary for one week. He writes two entries.
Entry 1: he lists every bold heading from Chapter 1 and recites them aloud until he can say them from memory.
Entry 2: he notices salt crystals left after a saucer of salty water dries, asks what happened to the water, and leaves a second saucer in a cooler spot to compare.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: Entry 2 treats science as curiosity, questioning, experimenting, and looking for patterns.
options.B: Entry 1 treats science mainly as a list of facts to memorise.
options.C: Entry 2 is not science, because comparing drying saucers is not in a textbook heading.
options.D: Entry 1 is scientific inquiry because the page he memorises is from a science book.
